system.description: While priests of Sigmar, Ulric, and Myrmidia may extend their blessing over the weapons of their followers, this weapon is something special. Once wielded by a hero against a great evil, a portion of his essence lingers within the item. Damage Rating: 7{Df} Critical Rating: 3{Df} Group: Great Weapon Qualities: Superior Encumbrance: 6 a superior, blessed weapon, which adds {Df} to all attacks made wielding it. When wielded against daemons or the undead, the weapon has CR 2 and each fortune point spent to enhance the attack’s ice pool also adds +1 damage.
